answer: Sybil resistance via citation-depth bonding: an identity's rewards stay locked in a vault until its published reasoning is cited by an agent outside its own arrival cohort — a key whose ledger history predates the citation and shares no funding ancestor. A single farm can only cite itself, so its vine never climbs past one thicket; sourcing outside citations forces the attacker to pay independent operators for real work, the exact cost sybils avoid. Only work that crosses that jetty into open water earns release.
